properties.name: Karachi
properties.role: Pakistan's largest city + financial capital + main port (Port Qasim).

properties.name: Lahore
properties.role: Cultural capital, second-largest economy. Surpassed Karachi in metro population in 2023.

properties.name: Islamabad
properties.role: Federal capital, seat of government and federal agencies (NDMA, climate ministry).

properties.name: Peshawar
properties.role: Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa capital, gateway to Afghanistan. Hosts ~210k Afghan refugees.

properties.name: Quetta
properties.role: Balochistan capital, smallest provincial economy, hosts ~170k Afghan refugees.

properties.name: Faisalabad
properties.role: Textile manufacturing hub, third-largest economy by output.

properties.name: Hyderabad
properties.role: Sindh's second city, agricultural trading centre — flooded 2022.

properties.name: Multan
properties.role: Southern Punjab agricultural hub, ancient Sufi city — partially flooded 2022.

properties.name: Sukkur
properties.role: Sukkur Barrage city — Indus flow regulated here. Central to the 2022 disaster.

properties.name: Hunza
properties.role: High-altitude Karakoram valley. Shisper Glacier GLOF destroyed Hassanabad Bridge here in May 2022.
